text:
Situation: Daptomycin 350 mg/7 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 114 vials (7.9 days at 14.5 vials/day). Corvale General holds 278 vials (18.3 days at 15.2 vials/day). Both sites receive product under NDC 71288001791 labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. with the manufacturing plant named on the label as Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include daptomycin as of 2026-10-21. FDA status shows "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory supports a short-term internal transfer to balance supply between campuses. Alternate manufacturers APOTEX CORP., Accord Healthcare Inc., and Aspiro Pharma Limited are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 64 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from APOTEX CORP. — requires buyer approval after plant verification.
3. Evaluate purchase from Accord Healthcare Inc. — requires buyer approval after plant verification.
4. Evaluate purchase from Aspiro Pharma Limited — requires buyer approval after plant verification.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
